source.method: every tracked file on main read through git; binary files skipped; one row per file and category, lines = matching lines in that file. The match patterns are not recorded here because they name the personal values; they move to the owner's installation repository with this inventory.

kinds.history: proof/ and releases/, specs and plans whose status is shipped, proven, released or closed, and the factory's own records under .veldo (events.jsonl, lessons.jsonl, decisions/, decision_reviews/, last_verify)
kinds.live_record: specs and plans still draft, ready or in progress: a contributor reads and edits them
kinds.live: code, defaults, fixtures, suites, packs, site, docs, README files and specs/index.md: behaviour or text a user runs or reads

owner_identity.description: the owner's name or personal email: spec owner fields, approval records, approver labels, git identities in code, prose and docs

team_and_assistant_names.description: first names of the owner's team members and the name of his personal assistant

accounts_and_labels.description: the owner's model-account labels, his named account and executor labels, tracker account ids and site ids

telegram_refs.description: Telegram message ids, the owner's chat id, and lines that cite or quote the owner's messages

company_products_vendors.description: the owner's company and legal entity, its products, repositories and projects, its industry terms, and its vendors and services

paths_and_hosts.description: absolute paths under the owner's home directory, path-encoded forms of them, and the owner's host name

secret_shapes.description: token or key shapes; every match is a documented public example value or a synthetic detector fixture, none is a live secret (masked below)

machine_specifics.description: the owner's machine: login uid in systemd unit and cgroup paths and runtime directories (no real tailnet name, device name or port of his was found; tailnet names and devices in the tree are example.ts.net and generic placeholders)

outside_the_tree.commit_identities: all 3294 commits on main carry the owner's name and one of his two company email addresses as author and committer; removed only by the fresh public history (AC4)
outside_the_tree.branch_and_worktree_names: agent branch names and worktree paths under the owner's home appear in proof records (counted under paths_and_hosts)
